UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile metadata, account details, and subscription tier

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: Full display name of the user

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL from Google Account

subscriptionTier.description: Active tier: FREE (1 traveler, max 1 of each bag type up to 3 total) or PRO (unlimited travelers and bags)

subscriptionBillingCycle.description: Billing cadence chosen by the subscriber

isSubscribed.description: Flag indicating if user has active paid subscription

subscriptionExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp for next renewal or subscription expiration

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile sync

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: Packing trip containing luggage bags, packed items, travelers, and gate checklists

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the trip owner

travelType.description: Transportation mode (PLANE, TRAIN, CAR, CRUISE, BUS)

seatClassOrCarSize.description: Seating tier, fare class, or vehicle class

departureTime.description: Planned travel departure time in HH:mm

departureCountdownEnabled.description: Flag indicating if live departure countdown timer is enabled

departureReminders.description: Smart pre-trip milestones and day-of critical travel reminders

familyMembers.description: List of travelers traveling together on this journey

bags.description: Bags assigned to travelers with packing items and weight thresholds

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile document containing user preferences and subscription status

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: Travel trips, luggage configurations, and packing checklists owned by the user
